scope: Independent semantic source review of the PC53 ordinary-options venue point loop and its spatial-metrics dispatch. Native provider/other-precision paths retain the prior loop.
checks: Point-coordinate differences still wrap as signed I32 before conversion. PC53 arithmetic helpers retain every original association and extended fallback; full m80 sine/cosine values are not prematurely rounded.

The original sine F64 spill occurs before its dx multiplication. LocalY and every nearest update spill to F64 at their original boundaries, including signed zero and immediate unsupported nonfinite load failures.

Orientation, coordinate, notch, zero, width, square limit, denominator, coefficient, multiplier and conditional override reads retain their original order and short circuit conditions. The multiplier address is still read twice.
Venues999/7 and background-point exceptions remain ordered identically. The complete routine still returns a Float80 carrying the nearest stored binary64 image.

Explicit, inherited and accessor sinCosX87 properties decline the numeric loop without invoking the provider getter at the guard. The original loop retains callback argument objects and per-point provider selection.
PC24/64 and unsupported options retain the original point loop. This review assumes ordinary host options; arbitrary Proxy observation is outside the guarded browser mode.
